sentences.en: If your windows are not airtight, moisture will seep in.
sentences.zh: 如果你的窗户密封不严，湿气就会渗进来。

sentences.en: Gas was seeping through a crack in the pipe.
sentences.zh: 气体通过管道上的裂缝渗出。

sentences.en: The blood seeped through my pantleg, and everyone knew I was wounded.
sentences.zh: 血液渗透到我的裤腿上，大家都明白我受伤了。

senses.zh: （液体）渗漏，渗透；逐渐移动，渐渐散开
